BiblicalUsage: Adoni-zedek was king of Jerusalem when he heard that Joshua had taken Ai and that the Gibeonites had made peace with Israel. In fear he gathered four other kings and besieged Gibeon, and Joshua marched all night to rescue it.
TheologicalSignificance: This king's name — 'my lord is righteousness' — is an irony Scripture lets stand without comment. I believe his story shows that titles do not make a man righteous, and that no alliance of kings can stand against the Lord who fights for His people.
